mapper.sql: a.id, a.title, a.cover_color, a.media_type, a.cover_url, CASE a.status WHEN 0 THEN 'DRAFT' WHEN 1 THEN 'PENDING' WHEN 2 THEN 'PUBLISHED' WHEN 3 THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN 4 THEN 'UNPUBLISHED' ELSE 'DRAFT' END AS status, a.category_id, c.name AS category_name, a.author_id, u.nickname AS author_name, u.avatar_url AS author_avatar, a.like_count, a.favorite_count, a.comment_count, a.reject_reason, a.submit_time, a.publish_time, a.create_time, a.update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM article a JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.author_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 2
AND ( a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') )
AND a.author_id = #{q.authorId}
AND a.category_id IN #{cid}
ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.title = #{q.keyword} THEN 0 WHEN a.title LIKE CONCAT(#{q.keyword}, '%') THEN 1 WHEN a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') THEN 2 WHEN c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') THEN 3 WHEN u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') THEN 4 ELSE 5 END ASC,
a.publish_time ASC, a.id ASC a.publish_time DESC, a.id DESC
ORDER BY a.publish_time ASC, a.id ASC ORDER BY a.publish_time DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.author_id, u.nickname AS author_name, a.category_id, c.name AS category_name, a.cover_color, COALESCE(a.submit_time, a.update_time) AS submit_time, a.update_time FROM article a JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.author_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1
AND (a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
AND a.category_id IN #{cid}
ORDER BY COALESCE(a.submit_time, a.update_time) ASC, a.id ASC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.cover_color, a.media_type, a.media_urls AS media_urls_raw, a.cover_url, CASE a.status WHEN 0 THEN 'DRAFT' WHEN 1 THEN 'PENDING' WHEN 2 THEN 'PUBLISHED' WHEN 3 THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN 4 THEN 'UNPUBLISHED' ELSE 'DRAFT' END AS status, a.author_id, u.nickname AS author_name, u.avatar_url AS author_avatar, a.category_id, c.name AS category_name, a.reject_reason, a.like_count, a.favorite_count, a.comment_count, a.submit_time, a.review_time, a.reviewer_id, r.nickname AS reviewer_name, a.publish_time, a.create_time, a.update_time FROM article a JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.author_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN sys_user r ON r.id = a.reviewer_id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0

SELECT id, title, content, category_id, cover_color, media_type, media_urls AS media_urls_raw, cover_url, CASE status WHEN 0 THEN 'DRAFT' WHEN 1 THEN 'PENDING' WHEN 2 THEN 'PUBLISHED' WHEN 3 THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN 4 THEN 'UNPUBLISHED' ELSE 'DRAFT' END AS status, reject_reason FROM article WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT ar.id, ar.action, ar.reviewer_id, u.nickname AS reviewer_name, ar.reason, CASE ar.from_status WHEN 0 THEN 'DRAFT' WHEN 1 THEN 'PENDING' WHEN 2 THEN 'PUBLISHED' WHEN 3 THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN 4 THEN 'UNPUBLISHED' ELSE 'DRAFT' END AS from_status, CASE ar.to_status WHEN 0 THEN 'DRAFT' WHEN 1 THEN 'PENDING' WHEN 2 THEN 'PUBLISHED' WHEN 3 THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN 4 THEN 'UNPUBLISHED' ELSE 'DRAFT' END AS to_status, ar.create_time FROM article_review ar JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ar.reviewer_id WHERE ar.article_id = #{articleId} ORDER BY ar.create_time DESC, ar.id DESC

SELECT CASE status WHEN 0 THEN 'DRAFT' WHEN 1 THEN 'PENDING' WHEN 2 THEN 'PUBLISHED' WHEN 3 THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN 4 THEN 'UNPUBLISHED' ELSE 'DRAFT' END AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM article WHERE author_id = #{authorId} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY status
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, category_id = #{categoryId}, media_type = #{mediaType}, media_urls = #{mediaUrls}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, status = #{newStatus}, reject_reason = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 1 THEN NULL ELSE reject_reason END, reviewer_id = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 1 THEN NULL ELSE reviewer_id END, review_time = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 1 THEN NULL ELSE review_time END, submit_time = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 1 THEN NOW() ELSE submit_time END, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND author_id = #{authorId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{expectedStatus} AND version = #{version}

UPDATE article SET status = #{toStatus}, reject_reason = CASE WHEN #{toStatus} IN (0, 1, 2) THEN NULL ELSE #{reason} END, reviewer_id = CASE WHEN #{toStatus} IN (0, 1) THEN NULL ELSE #{reviewerId} END, review_time = CASE WHEN #{toStatus} IN (0, 1) THEN NULL WHEN #{toStatus} IN (2, 3, 4) THEN NOW() ELSE review_time END, publish_time = CASE WHEN #{toStatus} = 2 THEN NOW() ELSE publish_time END, submit_time = CASE WHEN #{toStatus} = 1 THEN NOW() ELSE submit_time END, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE article SET deleted = 1, title = '已删除内容', content = '', category_id = NULL, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND author_id = #{authorId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{expectedStatus} AND status <> 1
UPDATE article SET deleted = 1, title = '已删除内容', content = '', category_id = NULL, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{expectedStatus}
